feeds.title: Pronunciation Studio Blog
feeds.description: The Pronunciation Studio blog is about sounds, accents, intonation, teaching, and the occasional hilarious excruciating joke. New lessons with audio are released by our teachers here regularly.

feeds.title: Adrian Underhill's Pronunciation Site Blog
feeds.description: This blog aims to provide information and foster discussion that could help teachers and learners of English to explore and experiment with more successful ways of integrating pronunciation.

feeds.title: Pronunciation Bites
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Marina Cantarutti, and I am an EFL teacher, an MA in the English Language. This blog will keep you updated on Pronunciation And Applied Phonetics in York, United Kingdom.

feeds.title: Pronunciation Workshop Blog
feeds.description: Pronunciation Workshop is the world's leader in English Pronunciation Training. See our Free English Pronunciation Tips and learn how we are empowering people all over the world to learn to speak 'Perfect English'!

feeds.title: Vocabulary Spelling City Blog
feeds.description: Vocabulary Spelling City is a game-based, interactive educational website used to build vocabulary, writing, spelling, & language arts skills.

feeds.title: English Pronunciation Roadmap
feeds.description: Want to speak more clearly and sound like a native? We'll give you your own Roadmap to natural, clear and confident British English Pronunciation. This is a learning hub for English pronunciation, accent reduction, and elocution.
